_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Methyl isobutyl ketone (2): isothermal total pressures at 338.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: F. Avoseh, S. A. Iwarere, C. Narasigadu, D. Ramjugernath, Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Methyl Isobutyl Ketone (MIBK) + (1-Propanol or 2-Propanol) Binary Mixtures, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 2014-2020
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
